text: Good evening. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 8. Her temperature was 38 earlier and she's been complaining her ear hurts. About twenty minutes ago she had what I think was a fit. She went stiff, her arms and legs were shaking and her eyes rolled back, maybe a minute or so. She's never had one before. Since then her breathing seems very fast to me and I think I can see her tummy pulling in under her ribs, though I may be wrong. I'd like to know what I should do.
